description: This file defines a Smarty plugin function 'sugar_getjspath' which generates a JavaScript cache path string for a given filename. It includes metadata and a function that integrates with the Smarty templating engine to append a cache-busting path.

methods.name: smarty_function_sugar_getjspath
methods.description: Generates a JavaScript path with cache string, triggered by the Smarty templating engine when {sugar_getjspath} is used.
